altered absolute_horizon and public_sanctions accepted while selection_digest unchanged
cells 1+1 accepted with denominator 100; no cell-sum/denominator validation
same request returns identical enriched receipt; no replay/nonce guard
result_hash hashes original receipt identity, not enriched receipt identity
H2 receipts synthesized from selection digest/world without calling provider refresh

findings.finding: sitecustomize auto-injects overlay without an environment/test-mode guard
findings.evidence: ordinary subprocess with candidate dir on PYTHONPATH printed True and sc0_pe_overlay
findings.impact: if copied near production import path, PE is monkeypatched globally
findings.recommendation: never merge sitecustomize; require explicit installer/plugin and fail-closed environment guard

findings.finding: altered fixture world accepted without selection-digest binding
findings.evidence: absolute_horizon=fx:ATTACKER_AH and public_sanctions=fx:sanction:attacker copied to receipt with original selection_digest
findings.impact: invented world data can be represented as enriched world data
findings.recommendation: pin provider/source digest and require value digest match to selection digest

findings.evidence: cells 1+1 with denominator 100 passed _validate_geometry and was emitted as n10e exact denominator
findings.impact: numeric integrity failure can be published as exact geometry
findings.recommendation: validate cell sums, probabilities and denominator record consistency

findings.finding: EnrichedResult.result_hash does not cover enriched receipt
findings.impact: downstream identity/replay may bind original receipt while material carries extra fields
findings.recommendation: define enriched result_hash over enriched receipt.ref

findings.finding: H2 refresh receipts are synthesized, not executed
findings.evidence: NoRefreshProvider raises on refresh methods yet _refresh_receipts returns channel receipts at generation 0
findings.impact: fabricated refresh receipts satisfy strict field presence without H2 event evidence
findings.recommendation: require executed provider refresh records or label field as fixture-only and do not claim refresh

findings.finding: test fixture reversal authority is unrestricted
findings.evidence: EXPLICIT_UNRESTRICTED target/risk scopes and ALL_TIME; _competent accepts attacker target/risk with same ref
findings.impact: if applied to a production registry, test snapshot impersonates a broad issuer
findings.recommendation: keep test-only; real integration requires exact issuer/target/risk/time scopes

findings.finding: source-promotion flag is overwritten rather than refused
findings.evidence: input may_use_as_source_observation=True yields output False without error
findings.recommendation: fail closed on contradictory echo state

findings.evidence: HELD_AUTHORITY row with scope=None is accepted and copied
findings.impact: negative status algebra can lose its source/risk coordinate
findings.recommendation: require scope/measure consistency for each status

findings.evidence: identical request returns identical receipt hash
findings.impact: replay is possible in a pure service boundary; PE is not a current issuer
findings.recommendation: keep as sourcefree limitation or add explicit replay custody if currentized

findings.finding: forged issuer and temporal invalidation are refused
findings.evidence: forged reversal -> TYPED_REFUSAL/REVERSED_UNAUTHORIZED_ROLE; as-of at request -> FUTURE_TIME_AVAILABILITY_REFUSED; invalidated -> INVALIDATED_CURRENT_REFUSED

findings.finding: missing producer/consumer and removed negative status fail closed

recoverable_into_current_sourcefree_succ: PE request/refusal law for forged reversal, future as-of and invalidated current
C1/N10E exact cell/denominator arithmetic from the original PE receipt
Value-carrying receipt fields if and only if bound to an owner provider digest and source values
Generic consumer values-read/effects if produced by real consumers, not fixture copies
not_recoverable_from_this_overlay: operative N9 world values, source release, source/actor authority
real negative-status source determinations and scopes
production result identity covering enriched fields
a real reversal issuer (test snapshot is unrestricted)
